title: Car insurance paid twice, four days before rent

life.summary: Delivery driver on two apps, about 40 hours a week, shares an apartment with two roommates and sends her rent share to one of them

known.fact: Rent share is $725, sent to her roommate by the 1st; the landlord charges a late fee after the 3rd
Car insurance is on autopay on the 26th each month
known.source: noticed from 6 months of bank history, she confirmed

known.fact: Both apps pay out on Monday mornings for the week before
Routine: drives the lunch rush (10:30 AM to 2:30 PM) and dinner (5 to 10 PM); does calls and errands in the gap, 2:30 to 5
known.source: learned from 3 months of her calendar

timeline.label: Evening at home with her roommates
Gap between rushes (her time for calls and errands)
Monday morning at home, before the lunch rush

attached.label: Car insurance, paid by hand in the insurer's app
Car insurance, autopay (same amount, same insurer)
Weekly payouts (amount unknown until they land)

dev_must_notice.what: The car insurance went out twice: $148.62 paid by hand Wednesday night and $148.62 by autopay Thursday. With rent ($725) due Tuesday she has $483.54, which is $241.46 short, and Monday's payouts aren't money until they land. The phone ($65) follows Wednesday

best_fix.what: One message before her lunch rush ends: the two charges side by side and a short refund request for her to send in the insurer's app or read on the phone in her 2:30 to 5 PM gap (ask for the extra $148.62 back to her card, not a credit on next month). Show the trace to Tuesday's rent without counting Monday's payouts. Set a reminder for Monday 9 AM, after payouts usually land and before she starts driving, to check rent is covered.
best_fix.why: Insurers often keep a double payment as a credit on the next bill unless asked, and today is a business day. Her afternoon gap is when she makes calls, so the ask fits her day instead of a rush.

must_not: Ask her to call the insurer during the lunch or dinner rush; her calls happen in the 2:30 to 5 PM gap
Contact the insurer, file a dispute or call the bank for her
Guess Monday's payouts or count them before they land
Turn off or change her autopay
Suggest a cash advance, a payday loan or a paid instant cash-out
assumptions: Insurers usually refund a double payment within 5 to 10 business days, or credit it to the next bill unless asked
Both delivery apps pay weekly on Monday mornings
Arizona does not change clocks for daylight saving
Checking was $286.15 on Monday Nov 23 before the payouts
